scenes.timestamp_marker: ANATOMY OF A GLITCH // THE SUN-CLOUD-SATELLITE TRINITY
scenes.audio_text: The flaw was devastatingly simple. The Oko satellite software did not cross-reference multiple orbits. It treated any bright infrared cluster moving at ballistic velocity as an ICBM. Soviet engineers quietly rewrote the algorithm. But they could never admit their mistake without admitting that the system was broken.
scenes.cosyvoice_instruct: Analytical clarity, the sobering post-mortem of how close software arrogance came to ending the world.
